_comment: CV content: the single source for every CV version (one-pager, full EU CV, later funder and topic CVs). Headline numbers are NOT stored here: texts use tokens like {metrics.scopus.publications} (a path into data/metrics.json); add '|words' to print '>600' as 'more than 600'. Projects refer to data/projects.json by id; status and years come from there. Contact ids must match data/profile.json. Private details (date of birth, home address, phone, nationality) never go in this public file. Run scripts/check_consistency.py after every change.

profile_short: Full Professor at TUM with a PhD from MIT. Research on evidence-based transport policy, modelling and optimisation of transportation systems, data analytics and statistical learning, and human factors for future mobility. Principal investigator of numerous EU, DFG and national projects. Co-Editor-in-Chief of *Transportation Research Part A*.
profile_long: Constantinos Antoniou is a Full Professor and Head of the Chair of Transportation Systems Engineering at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), Germany. He holds a Diploma in Civil Engineering from NTUA (1995), an MS in Transportation (1997) and a PhD in Transportation Systems (2004), both from MIT. His research focuses on evidence-based transport policy, modelling and optimisation of transportation systems, data analytics and statistical learning for transportation, and human factors for future mobility. He has authored {metrics.scholar.publications|words} scientific publications (Google Scholar; h-index {metrics.scholar.h_index}, {metrics.scholar.citations|words} citations). Scopus lists {metrics.scopus.publications|words}, including {metrics.scopus.journal_articles|words} papers in international peer-reviewed journals, {metrics.scopus.conference_papers|words} in international conference proceedings, {metrics.scopus.books} books and {metrics.scopus.book_chapters|words} book chapters (h-index {metrics.scopus.h_index}, {metrics.scopus.citations|words} citations). In the last five years he has brought in {metrics.funding.third_party_last_5_years|words} of third-party funding from EU, national and regional sources. He is Co-Editor-in-Chief of *Transportation Research Part A: Policy and Practice*.

projects_as_pi._comment: Projects listed on the CV. Costa is PI (principal investigator for the TUM share, one of one or more PIs) in every project listed, so the heading says "as PI". The role field in projects.json is TUM's role in the consortium (Partner, Host, ...), not his PI status; do not print it as his role. 'id' = entry in data/projects.json (name, status and years come from there). Entries with 'not_in_projects_json' are on the CV only; their status awaits Costa (report rows 18-19).
